title: API → S3 → Spark → Parquet
description: Land a paginated REST API into S3 raw, transform with PySpark into partitioned Parquet, and make the whole thing idempotent and testable offline.
implementation: Extract with an explicit cursor and a max-pages guard; log every request.
Land raw JSON untouched, keyed by ingestion date.

implementation.Transform: cast types explicitly, dedupe on the business key, add dt.

implementation: Write Parquet with INSERT OVERWRITE on dt so re-runs are safe.
repo_structure:
api-s3-spark-parquet/
  extract/api_client.py     # pagination, backoff, idempotency key
  transform/orders.py       # typed, deduped, partitioned
  extract/land_raw.py       # writes raw JSON, never overwrites silently
  tests/data/*.json         # tiny fixtures
  tests/test_orders.py
  docker-compose.yml        # minio + spark local
  Makefile
architecture:
REST API ─▶ [extract: paginate + retry] ─▶ S3 raw/ (JSON, immutable)
                                                  │
                                                  ▼
                                 [PySpark transform: type, dedupe, partition]
                                                  │
                                                  ▼
                                 S3 curated/ (Parquet, dt=.., Hive layout)
